consumer_findings: ItemInit appends _armor for set resource and explicit geo/texture locations, registers HEAD/CHEST/LEGS/FEET item suffixes. Three 2-argument callers default animated=false; shared Libraries idle animation is empty looping config, not three unique animations.

ArmorGear reload resolves config set ID then item fallback, mutates material/stats/max durability; constructor CHAIN is not proof final chain material. Config identity differs from visual material inference.

CLIENT MOD AddLayers registers ArmorGearRenderer; IClientItemExtensions selects renderer and applyEntityStats/setCurrentItem/applySlot. ArmorGearModel getters return stored resource locations. Real slot visibility resides also in external Gecko consumer, not proven by source names.

Renderer conditionally rotates by entity renderer/bone name, applies bone scale and CLOTH Body Z .93. Cubes obey hidden flags; overlay conditional compares SpawnArmoredMob armor registry reference with current armor set. No native wearing or collision/occlusion receipt.
Gear requests Libraries1.19.2-3.0.10-beta and Gecko3.1.40; inspected Libraries commit is3.0.12-beta/Gecko3.1.39. Fixed source binding is not requested binary equivalence.
